content.value_statement: React Native test setup and debugging can be difficult when components, hooks, and asynchronous behavior fail in different ways. This skill provides focused Jest and React Native Testing Library patterns to create and run clear tests.
actual_capabilities: Provides Jest setup commands and package scripts for React Native projects.
Supplies component test patterns for rendering and press interactions.
Supplies hook and utility test patterns with assertions.
Shows mock patterns for notifications, databases, and navigation.
Explains commands for full, watch, coverage, focused, and snapshot test runs.
Offers guidance for asynchronous tests, form validation, lists, and common failures.
limitations: It does not install dependencies or change project configuration by itself.
Examples may need adjustment for the project framework, Jest configuration, and React Native version.
It covers unit and integration testing patterns, not device, emulator, or end-to-end testing.
It does not guarantee that generated tests match every application behavior.

use_cases.title: Test a new component
use_cases.description: Create a focused render and interaction test for a React Native button or screen.

use_cases.title: Set up project testing
use_cases.description: Add Jest scripts and React Native Testing Library dependencies to a mobile project.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a failing test
use_cases.description: Use troubleshooting guidance for missing elements, mocks, timeouts, and asynchronous assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Start a component test
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Jest test for my React Native Button component. It renders a title and calls onPress when pressed.

prompt_templates.title: Test a custom hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Write tests for my useCounter hook. It starts at zero and exposes increment and reset methods.

prompt_templates.title: Mock a dependency
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to mock expo-router in Jest for a React Native screen that calls router.push.

prompt_templates.title: Debug an async form test
prompt_templates.prompt: Help debug my React Native login form test. The validation message appears after submit, but my assertion cannot find it.

output_examples.input: Create a test for a button that calls onPress.
output: A Jest test that renders the button with a title.
A press interaction using React Native Testing Library.
An assertion that verifies onPress was called once.

output_examples.input: How do I run coverage for my mobile tests?
output: Add a test:coverage script that runs Jest with coverage.
Run the project command for the coverage script.
Review the generated coverage report for untested paths.
Check for unresolved promises or missing mocks.
Use findBy queries or waitFor for delayed UI updates.
Keep the assertion focused on observable behavior.

best_practices: Test user-visible behavior instead of internal implementation details.
Mock external services so tests stay isolated and repeatable.
Use async query helpers when UI updates occur after promises resolve.
anti_patterns: Do not assert private component state when a user-visible result can be tested.
Do not rely on arbitrary timeouts instead of waiting for expected UI changes.
Do not leave network, database, or navigation dependencies unmocked in unit tests.

faq.question: Which tools does this skill support?
faq.answer: It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What test libraries does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Jest and React Native Testing Library patterns.

faq.question: Can it test custom hooks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a renderHook example for testing hook state and actions.

faq.question: Does it support mocking?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows mocks for notifications, database clients, and navigation.

faq.question: Can it help with async test failures?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends findBy queries and waitFor for delayed updates.

faq.question: Does it provide end-to-end device testing?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Jest-based unit and integration testing.
